notes.content:
The [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/feralcatden/nirvana-noir]Kickstarter campaign[/url] for Nirvana Noir has reached its goal! 

With just 72 hours left, now's your chance to add a message/doodle in game, nab some amazing rewards, and help the project hit some exciting stretch goals!

In No Man’s next adventure, you’ll solve the mysteries of the Bigger Bang and delve into two parallel realities - one where the Big Bang led to a new reality of color and sin, and one where the Big Bang was never fired. 

A special moment in the Nirvana Noir will feature the messages and doodles of Kickstarter backers, and the more that get submitted the more psychedelically unforgettable the game will be!

If you back at The Collaborator tier, your message will be part of the game's story and themes, and it will be seen by other players who will explore The Constant. Your message will add your unique perspective and voice to the game, and it will enrich the experience for everyone.

notes.title: Nirvana Noir launches its Kickstarter campaign!
notes.content:
What is it like to live in a city where a gunshot can create the entire universe? Detectives, it’s time to venture deeper!

Feral Cat Den, the creators behind the BAFTA-nominated game, Genesis Noir, has kicked off a special [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/feralcatden/nirvana-noir]Kickstarter campaign[/url] for its long-awaited sequel, Nirvana Noir! In No Man’s next adventure, you’ll solve the mysteries of the Bigger Bang and delve into two parallel realities - one where the Big Bang led to a new reality of color and sin, and one where the Big Bang was never fired.

In the lead up to launch, we’d love your help in expanding its cosmic universe by becoming a backer for Nirvana Noir. Backers will receive a special thanks in the game credits and access to exclusive development updates, as well as a range of amazing rewards, merch, and collectables.

notes.title: Announcing: Nirvana Noir!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=bfQm9FuAYEw;full][trailer][/previewyoutube]
Today, we’re excited to announce the follow-up to the much beloved Genesis Noir, please welcome Nirvana Noir to the Fellow Traveller line up! Revealed as part of The Day of the Devs showcase, Nirvana Noir is the next adventure for No Man. The cosmic watchmaker pursues mysteries across two parallel realities - one where the Big Bang was never fired, the other where it did, leading to an explosion of color and sin. It’s up to the player to solve the mysteries of the Bigger Bang when Nirvana Noir launches on [url=https://bit.ly/NirvanaNoirXbox]Xbox Series X|S[/url] and [url=https://bit.ly/NirvanaNoirSteam]PC[/url].

[b]Double the Trouble with two realities[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32519490/22cfebd4861e0ea2e170a88dc4ac7426a1388eaa.gif[/img]

In Black Rapture, No Man labors to complete the intricate mechanisms of a clocktower but is disrupted when a series of arsons break out across the cosmic city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32519490/19f036616bcb140d542c588f564579e55e762270.gif[/img]

Constant Testament is an explosion of color and sin. No Man is coerced by the police to investigate a dangerous new drug whose appearance is intertwined with an old flame.

Play will jump across the different realities in an effort to save both.

[b]New mechanics, new tunes[/b]
Like Genesis Noir, No Man’s previous adventure, Nirvana Noir is a seamless blend of animation and interactivity and is overflowing with unique puzzles and interactions. In a quest to solve these mysteries you’ll find yourself:
[list]
[*] Reconstructing a demolished building
[*] Mounting a legal defense
[*] Collecting the last words of characters you meet
[*] Finding skeletons in closets
[*] Trying not to break under interrogation
[*] Interviewing witnesses
[*] Manipulating words to get to the hidden truth behind them
[*] Following the word on the street
[*] And much more…
[/list]Work to solve these mysteries to the tune of another amazing jazz-inspired soundtrack that reacts and responds to your actions. Nirvana Noir features both noir and neo-noir influences, as well as music-focused puzzles and interactions. All music and sound design in the game is done by [url=https://skillbard.com/]Skillbard[/url], an award-winning London-based team of composers and sound designers who work in film, television, games, sound art, pop music, and sonic branding.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1287610/Nirvana_Noir/

Nirvana Noir will launch on [url=https://bit.ly/NirvanaNoirXbox]Xbox Series X|S[/url] and [url=https://bit.ly/NirvanaNoirSteam]PC[/url]. For more updates, check out [url=https://feralcatden.com/]Feral Cat Den’s website[/url], follow [url=https://twitter.com/fellowtravellr]us[/url] on Twitter/X and join the [url=https://discord.gg/sk89hQj57x]Fellow Traveller Discord[/url].
